SELECT date_trunc('week', f.sale_date) wk, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) logged_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN o.web_order_id END) lines_missing_member, (SUM(CASE WHEN o.member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) order_member_not_in_dim, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) max_load
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND o.status<>'cancelled' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date, f.member_key AS line_member_key, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       COUNT(*) n_lines,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS web_net_before_returns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net_fixed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net_linekey,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL AND l.order_member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS line_member_but_order_null,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL AND l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL AND l.order_member_key<>l.line_member_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keys_differ,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS share_fixed,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS share_linekey
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
